A '''proton pack''' was a device that could power a [[Mind evaporator/Legends|mind evaporator]]. On [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]], [[Saun Dann]] brought [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]] a new proton pack as well as an erotic [[cassette]], which allowed the old [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] to spend some quality time with [[Mermeia]].
